name: Default
shortDescription: Browser-based spreadsheet built in Rust and WebAssembly: formulas, dynamic arrays, tables, pivot tables, charts, conditional formatting and native XLSX, CSV and TSV open and save.

alerts.message: Workbooks are not stored on the server: the web app runs in the browser and keeps only preferences there. Save or export your workbooks to your own device before closing the tab.
The upstream project publishes no container image; this one is built by a community maintainer from the source of the official release tags.
